clues.it: Bruno era nella 6ª colonna, accanto a un barile e a nord di Irene.
clues.en: Bruno was in the 6th column, beside a barrel and north of Irene.

clues.it: Nino era nella 1ª colonna e nella stessa stanza di Olga.
clues.en: Nino was in the 1st column and in the same room as Olga.

clues.it: Olga era a ovest di Giada.
LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Giada era nella 10ª colonna, nella 5ª riga e da sola nel Faro.
clues.en: Giada was in the 10th column, in the 5th row and alone in the Lighthouse.

clues.it: Anna era accanto a una sedia e a ovest di Bruno.
clues.en: Anna was beside a chair and west of Bruno.

clues.it: Rosa era nella 7ª riga e in una stanza diversa da Fabio.
clues.en: Rosa was in the 7th row and in a different room from Fabio.

clues.it: Fabio era nella 5ª colonna e nella 8ª riga, ma non era accanto a una corda.
clues.en: Fabio was in the 5th column and in the 8th row, but was not beside a rope coil.

clues.it: Tea era nella 9ª colonna, ma non era accanto a una pozza.
clues.en: Tea was in the 9th column, but was not beside a puddle.

clues.it: Irene era nella 2ª colonna, accanto a una pianta e in una stanza diversa da Rosa.
clues.en: Irene was in the 2nd column, beside a plant and in a different room from Rosa.

general_clues.en: 5 in the west half of the grid.
5 in the north half of the grid.

steps.it: L'indizio di Giada lascia una sola casella libera: riga 5ª, colonna 10ª.
steps.en: Giada's own clue leaves a single free square: row 5th, column 10th.

steps.en: Rosa can only be in the 7th row: ruling it out leaves Bruno a single square: row 1st, column 6th.
